message:
Hi Nalini!!!
This is a really cool tool. I think it would be a good idea to add a feature for people who don’t necessarily need directions to a specific destination, but want to walk a certain distance or for a set amount of time for exercise/meditation. My mom goes on daily walks and usually either sets a timer for 30 minutes or walks 2 miles then turns around and heads home. A feature like this would allow her to plan her walking route while avoiding unsafe or less pedestrian-friendly paths along the way. Hope this helps. Best of luck with everything 🫡
how can we expand the tool to frisco?
I feel like you should start scaling this up!
